title: maybe happy ending indeed? #broadway #musicaltheatre #theatre #darren...
transcript: Even after all this, people are still sleeping on Maybe Happy Ending. Their grosses have been considerably weaker since Darren Criss left. And to some extent that's understandable. But it also means I might be wrong about something I said last year. When the whole Andrew Barth Feldman controversy happened last year, there were a lot of people saying, “well, this is just the reality of Broadway.” “They need a recognizable name to keep show afloat.” And, you know, it's up for debate whether Andrew Barth Feldman was actually a meaningful draw at the box office. But putting that aside, what I said in response to that was, yes, celebrity casting has proven to be one of the most successful models on Broadway. And I am, maybe controversially, pro-celebrity casting. But what I said was I think maybe happy ending specifically, more so than other shows, was well-positioned to establish itself as a popular, long running title without relying on that model because of its Tony wins and because its word of mouth appeal was so strong. And while I don't know if it's a cheap show to run, the small cast certainly doesn't hurt. So it's very disappointing that my prediction, or hope, is proving to be at least partly wrong, with the show running probably below its operating cost throughout this summer. Though I still kind of stand by what I said in the sense that the show maybe did possess that potential, whether it came to fruition or not. Maybe it still will! I'm not trying to talk about this show like it's already announced closing. It hasn't, and I hope it doesn't. But at least so far, it doesn't seem like the show itself, as a title or property, has quite managed to get that solid foothold with general tourist audiences. Which is a shame, because not only do I think it's one of the best musicals on Broadway right now, it's also one that I feel like I can recommend pretty broadly to all sorts of people looking for a show. Having said all of that, if we must rely on celebrity casting to keep Maybe Happy Ending open, when are we getting Laufey as Claire, folks?
